prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one small unlit 2D animation-rig color layer
Primary request: Draw exactly one straight connected tapered rounded panel running from upper-left to lower-right. Its solid upper end is only slightly wider than its body; its solid lower end is narrower. The centerline stays straight.
Color sequence: short pale-peach upper section; one narrow deep-navy band containing one tiny dull-gold four-point mark on the screen-right side; long light lavender-gray section; one narrow hard slate-lavender shadow strip; short solid light lavender-gray lower overlap.
Shape construction: one closed die-cut silhouette made from uniform color planes. Both ends are flush rounded extensions of that silhouette. Preserve a broad hidden overlap zone at each end.
Rendering: unlit production cel art with uniform matte fills, crisp hard color boundaries, one thin slate-gray closed contour, and only a one-pixel antialiased outer edge. No bloom, aura, rim light, cast shadow, reflection, ambient haze, soft-focus field, feathered exterior, or presentation lighting.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete component centered and uncropped on a square canvas, occupying about 14 percent of width and 42 percent of height, with generous unused margins.
Constraints: one component and one view only; no pair, duplicate, detached cap, hollow end, opening, bend, extra appendage, full character, other garment, detached mark, prop, stand, floor, scenery, text, logo, signature, watermark, sprite sheet, atlas, turnaround, panel grid, or inset.
